channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: KTR Distributes Fee Cheques to 16 MBBS Students in Hyderabad Under BLR Charitable Trust Initiative
item.description: KTR distributes fee cheques to 16 MBBS students in Hyderabad under the BLR Charitable Trust initiative organised by Uppal MLA Bandari Lakshma Reddy.

item.title: Huzurnagar Housing Project to Be Inaugurated on March 14, Says Uttam Kumar Reddy
item.description: Huzurnagar housing project for poor families will be inaugurated on March 14, says Uttam Kumar Reddy. The 110-acre housing colony will provide 2,160 houses for underprivileged families.

item.title: Indian Rupee Falls to Historic Low, Dollar Crosses ₹92 for the First Time
item.description: Indian Rupee hits a historic low as the US Dollar crosses ₹92 for the first time, closing at ₹92.05 per dollar amid global tensions and market pressure.

item.title: Nitish likely to file nominations for Rajya Sabha polls
item.description: State minister Vijay Kumar Chaudhary had confirmed on Wednesday that Kumar was considering entering the Rajya Sabha, which would bring to an end his tenure as the longest-serving chief minister of the state.

item.title: Heavy Rain Likely in Telangana in the Coming Days
item.description: According to weather experts, unseasonal rains are likely to return to the state after March 18 or 19. Officials said that the expected rainfall could be more intense than the showers experienced on February 23 and 24 last month.

item.title: Minor lynched in Bengal’s Malda after firing during Holi clash
item.description: It is reported that the house was extensively vandalised after the irate mob stormed into it. It is also alleged that the minor was severely thrashed by the violent mob, and he died on the way to the hospital.

item.title: Bihar cadre IPS officer appears before Andhra Police in ex-MP’s torture case
item.description: Bihar cadre IPS officer, M. Sunil Kumar Naik, on Thursday appeared before Andhra Pradesh Police for questioning in the alleged custodial torture of former Member of Parliament K. Raghu Ramakrishna Raju, who is now Deputy Speaker of Andhra Pradesh Assembly.

item.title: Austria Arrive in Hyderabad for FIH World Cup 2026 Qualifiers Hyderabad, Telangana
item.description: Austria has a rich history at the FIH Hockey Women’s World Cup, having appeared in three of the first four editions of the competition. However, they haven’t qualified for the premier event since 1981.

item.title: T20 World Cup: Mumbai’s weather and pitch report ahead of IND vs ENG semis clash
item.description: The defending champions India will face two-time winners England in the second semi-final of the ICC T20 World Cup 2026 to be played at the iconic Wankhede Stadium on Thursday.

item.title: Pawan Kalyan-starrer Ustaad Bhagat Singh’s release advanced to March 19!
item.description: A day after announcing they had brought music director Thaman on board the unit of the film in addition to music director Devi Sri Prasad, the makers of director Harish Shankar's action entertainer 'Ustaad Bhagat Singh', featuring actor Pawan Kalyan in the lead, on Thursday announced that the film would now release on March 19, a week ahead of the earlier announced date of March 26.
